units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 2:1">Peah II, 1</cite> <he>הנחל והש׳</he> a brook or a pool; <cite ref="Bava Batra 55a">B. Bath. 55ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 61a:15">B. Kam. 61ᵃ</cite>, expl.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 61a:15">ib.</cite> <he>מקום … שוללין שם</he> a place where the rain makes booty (inroads); oth. expl. <he>אמת המים שמחלקת שלל וכ׳</he> a water arm which imparts &c., v. <cite ref="A00332"><he>אֲגַף</he></cite>; <cite ref="Menachot 71b">Men. 71ᵇ</cite>; Sifra K’dosh. Par. 1, ch. II.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 6:23">Tosef. B. Kam. VI, 23</cite>; Y. ib. VI, end, 5ᶜ; Bab.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 61a:10">ib. 61ᵃ</cite> <he>עברה נהר או ש׳ וכ׳</he> if the fire crosses a river or a pool eight cubits wide.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 21b:3">B. Mets. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>בשְׁלוּלִיתוֹ של נהר</he>, v. <cite ref="G00156"><he>זֶוֶט</he></cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 2:2">Tosef. ib. II, 2</cite> <he>משלוליתו של ים ומשׁלוליתו של נהר</he> (Var. <he>משניתו … ומשניתו</he>) from the deposits of the tide or &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 10:2:2">Y. B. Kam. X, 7ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>משְׁלִילִית</he>, v. <cite ref="U01580"><he>שְׁנוּנִית</he></cite>.
